name: analysis_derived_semantic_prerequisites_v1
gate_semantics: This amendment changes prerequisite implementation provenance only. It does not change the H3 matrix, capacity, QD, LPDDR/storage measurements, penalty bounds, thresholds, causal expert-service assumption, or page-cache/Belady semantics. Frozen-only prerequisites remain bound to e08; newly derived semantic prerequisites may be emitted by the causal analysis HEAD and must be explicitly SHA-bound in the prerequisite manifest.
claim_boundary: The placement prerequisite compares the exact ordered prompt bytes, PLE row sequence, and atomic top-k MoE routing sequence across resident and mmap PLE placements while removing run-local request UUIDs, timing, endpoint metadata, and runtime event batching. It is a semantic-invariance control, not a performance result.
